fractured-halo:afterSkillBurst.label: After her Skill or Burst
fractured-halo:afterSkillBurst.reason: Its ATK bonus lasts 20 seconds after her Elemental Skill or Burst, so it is up while she casts either when it is ready.

fractured-halo:afterShield.label: Shield made
fractured-halo:afterShield.reason: It needs her to make a shield while the ATK bonus is up, and it only raises Lunar-Charged DMG.
